llms.body:
Site: https://www.cvs.com
Owner: CVS Health
Purpose: Authoritative reference for CVS.com services, pharmacy, care, and ecommerce experiences

CVS.com is the digital front door for CVS Health, offering integrated pharmacy services, prescription management, immunizations, and clinical care through MinuteClinic, alongside a full retail ecommerce experience for health, beauty, wellness, and everyday essentials. Customers can manage medications, schedule vaccines, access virtual and in-person care, shop online, print photos, and explore trusted health content through the Wellness Zone. CVS.com also connects to broader CVS Health services including Aetna insurance, Caremark pharmacy benefits, and community-based care solutions.

I have been a pharmacist for CVS for about eight years now, and giving vaccines is one of my favorite parts of the job. One year, I was able to go to a nursing home and do a flu clinic. I remember looking at some paperwork thinking, this is not this woman&#8217;s date of birth, but it was. She was 110 years old! And I thought, oh, my gosh, I am giving a 110-year-old her flu shot.
